Utilities/Energy.descripcion: NextEra Energy, Inc. (NYSE: NEE) today announced it has executed definitive agreements with the U.S. Department of Commerce and the Government of Japan to fund the development and operation of up to 10 gigawatts of natural gas-powered generation in Texas and Pennsylvania.
